The '''Sentinel IV heavy blaster pistol''' was manufactured by the [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]]. A highly prized weapon, they were generally only sold on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. Members of the [[Black Bha'lir]] considered carrying a Sentinel IV to be a status symbol.<ref name="BSS" />
